about.title: Experience Africa before you travel
about.lede: TravelMateVR is built by Mates Technologies Limited in Mbeya, Tanzania, to help travellers see a place properly before they commit to it, and to help local tourism businesses be seen.
about.vision: Choosing a trip shouldn't depend on a few edited photos. We combine immersive 360° previews, honest information and an AI planner with a marketplace of local partners, so travellers decide with confidence and more of the value of tourism stays in the places they visit.

pillars.d: Look around stays, parks and towns in 360° or panoramic previews before you book.
Describe your trip in your own words and get a costed, day-by-day plan you can change.
Operators, lodges, guides and community businesses offer their services directly.
We show eco and community claims only with evidence and highlight community-led experiences.
Available in English, French, German, Mandarin and Italian, on phones, computers and VR headsets.

pillars.t: One place for the whole trip
pillars.d: Discovery, planning, booking, documents and support during your journey.

p: Many travellers book African trips from a distance, with little sense of what a lodge, a walk or a neighbourhood will really feel like. Many excellent local businesses have no good way to show what they offer.
TravelMateVR brings both together: immersive previews for travellers and a fair, transparent marketplace for partners.

list: Explore destinations and experiences in 360°, on any screen.
Plan with AI TravelMate or build your own itinerary.
Book stays, safaris, activities and transport with the full price shown up front.
Keep everything for your trip in the Trip Control Center, available offline.

p: TravelMateVR is in its first release. Some listings are sample businesses used to demonstrate the marketplace and are clearly labelled. Our founding partners' listings show indicative prices that they confirm directly.

about.ctaText: Find a destination, look around, and plan the trip that suits you.

sustainability.title: Tourism that gives back
sustainability.lede: We want every booking to support the people and places that make a journey worth taking.

list: Highlight community-led and locally owned businesses.
Show conservation and community contributions transparently in the price.
Publish eco and community claims only when partners provide evidence.
Encourage longer stays and overland options where they make sense.

p: “Community-led” means hosts receive income directly or through a community fund. “Eco-certified” names the certification a partner holds. If you think a claim is wrong, tell us through the Help Center and we'll review it.

list: Use local guides and keep a respectful distance from wildlife.
Reduce single-use plastic; carry a refillable bottle.
Respect local dress and customs, especially in places of worship.

security.title: Security
security.lede: How we protect your account, payments and data.

p: Payments are processed by a PCI-compliant payment partner. Card details are entered on the partner's secure page and never reach TravelMateVR.

list: All traffic is encrypted with HTTPS.
Access to personal data is limited to staff and partners who need it to deliver your booking.
We keep only what's necessary, such as the last four characters of document numbers.
Use a unique password, or sign in with Google.
We will never ask for your password or full card number by phone, email or WhatsApp.
Check that messages about bookings mention your real booking ID.

p: If you find a security issue or receive a suspicious message using our name, contact us straight away. We review every report.

s1.d: Tell us where you can film and share links to your work.

s2.d: We confirm the places, the shot list and the creator agreement.

s3.d: Film in 360° and upload the master files through your creator account.

s4.d: Our team checks stitching and quality, adds narration and hotspots, and publishes.

s5.d: Every qualified view and every minute watched is counted. Earnings are paid out monthly.

creators.wantedText: {{count}} experiences and destinations only have a photo preview today. These are first in line.

spec.s1: Equirectangular (2:1), at least 4K; 5.7K or higher recommended.
spec.s2: 25–60 fps, H.264, H.265 or ProRes masters; stabilised, with a level horizon.
spec.s3: Camera at eye height (about 1.6 m) on a tripod or monopod; hide the stand where you can.
spec.s4: Clips of 30 seconds to 3 minutes, with a clear forward direction for the first view.
spec.s5: Natural or spatial (ambisonic) sound; no music you don’t hold the rights to.
spec.s6: Avoid fast camera moves: travellers watch in headsets too.

specP.p2: Bracketed or HDR exposure for bright skies and dark interiors.
specP.p3: No visible stitching errors; nadir patched or covered.
specP.p4: One photo per viewpoint; several viewpoints can be linked as a walk-through.

rights.a: You keep the copyright. You give TravelMateVR a licence to show your capture on the platform and in its marketing, as set out in the creator agreement.

consent.q: What about people in my shots?
consent.a: Get consent from people who can be recognised, and follow local rules on filming at religious and cultural sites. Faces and number plates can be blurred before publishing.

payout.q: How and when am I paid?
payout.a: Each month you earn {{perK}} per 1,000 qualified views plus your share of the creator pool ({{share}}% of subscription revenue, split by watch time). The payout method and schedule are set out in the creator agreement.

attribution.a: A view counts once someone has watched your experience for {{seconds}} seconds or more. Repeat views by the same person on the same day count once, and automated traffic is filtered out.

drones.a: Only where it is legal and with the permits the country requires. Many parks and heritage sites ban drones; we will tell you if a place does.

operators.q: I run tours. Can I film my own business?
operators.a: Yes. Operators can join as creators and as partners: list your tours on the marketplace and capture them in 360° for your listing.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lede: Everything you might want to know before you explore, plan, book or partner with us.
faq.moreText: Our team is happy to help. Visit the Help Center, write to {{email}} or message us on WhatsApp.

items.a: TravelMateVR helps you experience destinations before you travel. You can look around places, stays and tours in 360°, plan your journey and book trusted local partners, so you decide with confidence.
TravelMateVR is built by Mates Technologies Limited, a technology company based in Mbeya, Tanzania.
Exploring destinations, watching immersive experiences and planning trips are free. When you book, the price you see includes taxes and a small service fee.
English, French, German, Chinese and Italian. Change the language from the globe icon at the top of the page.

items.q: Where can I book and pay?
items.a: Bookings and payments are currently open for services in Tanzania, including Zanzibar.

items.q: Why can't I book a destination outside Tanzania?
items.a: Other destinations are preview-only until we launch there. You can already explore them in 360° and plan your trip; booking opens as soon as local partners and payments are in place.

items.q: Which payment methods can I use?
items.a: M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Mixx by Yas and HaloPesa, or a Visa or Mastercard card from any bank, including CRDB, NMB, NBC, Stanbic and TCB. Direct bank payments are coming soon.
Licensed tour operators, hotels, lodges, camps, guides, transport providers, restaurants and event organisers.
You can start on a commission-only plan, with no monthly fee, and move to a paid plan with more tools when you're ready. Exact terms are set out in your partner agreement.

items.q: How do I get 360° content of my business?
items.a: Upload your own 360° video or photos from your dashboard, or request a capture by our team or a creator in your area.
Connect a mobile-money number or a Tanzanian bank account. Payouts follow the schedule in your settings once your account is verified.

items.q: My business is outside Tanzania. Can I join?
items.a: Yes. Apply now and prepare your storefront and content. You'll start receiving bookings and payouts as soon as we launch in your country.

items.q: How can a tourism board work with TravelMateVR?
items.a: Manage how your destination appears, publish news and travel advisories, run campaigns and see what travellers are interested in, from your own dashboard.
Yes. Show the places you protect, highlight community and conservation contributions, and help visitors arrive informed and respectful.
Creators earn from every qualified view of their experiences and receive a share of subscription revenue, split by watch time. Rates are shown on the Creators page.
You keep the copyright. You give TravelMateVR a licence to show your content on the platform, as set out in the creator agreement.
A 360° camera that records at least 4K equirectangular video or 6000 × 3000 px photos. Our capture guidelines explain the rest.
